## Problem Statement

A clear description of what problem this feature would solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Impact on Performance

How do you expect this feature to affect Pulse's overhead? Would it be opt-in only?

## Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented (new module, config option, engine change), describe them here.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples from other software.
